message.content: {"note_claim": "The damage to the Edinburgh Garden of Remembrance was caused by Storm Boelo, not by people's actions.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "The Met Office has issued an upgraded amber weather warning for strong winds starting from 9pm on Saturday, October 24 until 9pm on Sunday, October 25 as Storm Boelo hits the Capital.", "reason": "The page confirms Storm Boelo brought strong winds of up to 70 mph to Edinburgh over the weekend, and that Princes Street Gardens—where the Garden of Remembrance is located—was closed due to the storm, directly supporting the note's claim that storm damage, not human action, was the cause."}

parsed.note_claim: The damage to the Edinburgh Garden of Remembrance was caused by Storm Boelo, not by people's actions.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The Met Office has issued an upgraded amber weather warning for strong winds starting from 9pm on Saturday, October 24 until 9pm on Sunday, October 25 as Storm Boelo hits the Capital.
parsed.reason: The page confirms Storm Boelo brought strong winds of up to 70 mph to Edinburgh over the weekend, and that Princes Street Gardens—where the Garden of Remembrance is located—was closed due to the storm, directly supporting the note's claim that storm damage, not human action, was the cause.
